Ensure the efficient daily operation of the Brussels office and support the team in achieving objectives.
 

Manage the team’s annual calendar, integrating all Group and Entity deadlines.
 

Organize internal and external meetings, seminars, and events, handling logistics, participant coordination, and agenda preparation.
 

Prepare accurate presentations, draft meeting minutes, and ensure follow-up on agreed actions.
 

Optimize the manager’s schedule, including professional trips, document preparation, reporting, and budget oversight.
 

Monitor and prioritize the manager’s emails, addressing urgent matters and responding when needed.
 

Consolidate and analyze information to ensure smooth internal and external operations.
 

Respond promptly to requests, ensuring alignment with Group values and maintaining a positive image.
 

Collect necessary information for the manager’s activities and address specific issues as required.
 

Manage purchases, validate expenses, and oversee budget monitoring when delegated.
 

Facilitate communication within the assistants’ network, organizing regular meetings and ensuring smooth collaboration.
 

Provide hierarchical or functional management of assistants as needed.

Strong organizational and time management skills to handle schedules, priorities, and deadlines.
 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a high level of proficiency in English.
 

Proficiency in software and tools (e.g., Microsoft Office) for data and budget management.
 

Detail-oriented and proactive mindset to ensure accuracy and smooth operations.
 

Problem-solving and adaptability to address challenges effectively.
 

Team collaboration and leadership abilities to coordinate with colleagues and assistants.

As part of the ASP service within the IT department, client is looking for a Software Asset Management Officer to ensure reliable, compliant, and optimized management of the IT software license portfolio.

The assignment combines administrative, analytical, and monitoring activities, with a strong focus on coordination between IT, Procurement, and Finance teams. The consultant will contribute to cost control, license compliance, and the continuous improvement of Software Asset Management processes.
Key responsibilities

• Manage the complete lifecycle of IT licenses: request, approval, acquisition, deployment, monitoring, and renewal

• Maintain an accurate, reliable, and up-to-date database of active, expired, renewable, and licenses to be retired

• Analyze contracts, terms of use, and license clauses in collaboration with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

• Analyze software usage data to identify unused, underused, or oversized licenses

• Propose optimization actions to reduce costs and improve license utilization

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators covering active licenses, unused licenses, upcoming renewals, compliance risks, and potential savings

• Prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards to support management decision-making

• Provide administrative and analytical follow-up for Software Asset Management activities

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of SAM processes and data quality

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate has solid experience in Software Asset Management or IT Asset Management, combined with strong administrative, analytical, and license-management skills.

They are able to work independently, analyze complex data, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate effectively with various internal and external stakeholders.

Mandatory skills

• Minimum 3 years of experience in a role related to:

• Software Asset Management

• IT License Management

• IT Asset Management

• IT Procurement

• or a similar function

• Good knowledge of software licensing models from major software vendors

• Experience analyzing and monitoring software contracts and licensing terms

• Strong ability to analyze software usage data

• Good knowledge of at least one analytical tool such as advanced Excel, SQL, or Power BI

• Ability to prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards

• French or Dutch with fluent English

• Strong administrative rigor and ability to manage multiple cases efficiently

• Autonomous, proactive, and ownership-driven mindset

 

Strong assets

• Experience with SAM/ITAM solutions

• Strong knowledge of SQL and/or Power BI

• Experience with software cost optimization and renewal management

• Experience working in a complex IT or large-enterprise environment

• Experience collaborating with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

Professional & soft skills

• Excellent analytical skills

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

• Autonomous and responsible

• Proactive with a strong sense of initiative

• Strong ownership and accountability

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills

• Ability to work cross-functionally with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

• Results-oriented and focused on continuous improvement

• Critical thinking and solution-oriented approach

• Handle general accounting, invoice management, VAT, budget, forecasts, audits, and risk management 
 
• Work closely with other companies at an international level 
 
• Participate in hands-on accounting practices with internal training provided by team members 
 
• Ensure the management of financial processes within the company 
 
• Contribute to various accounting tasks related to agriculture and the agrifood sector 

 
 
• Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field 
 
• Proficiency in English (minimum C1) and French (minimum B2) 
 
• Previous experience in an accounting environment is a plus, but not mandatory 
 
• Open-minded, with the ability to ask questions and express oneself confidently in English 
 
• Motivated, autonomous, and ready to thrive in a dynamic and international environment

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
 
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
 
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
 
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
 
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas. 

 
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
 
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
 
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
 
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

At Allseas, we enable the development of groundbreaking offshore solutions that support the energy transition. Our success depends on making informed decisions, managing resources effectively, and continuously improving the way we operate.
 

Within Business Finance, we act as trusted partners to the business, enabling sustainable performance through cost transparency, financial planning, data-driven insights, and strong financial governance. We challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and support the business in turning strategy into results.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a 
Finance Business Partner for Crewing.
 

 
 

Your role
 

 
 

As Finance Business Partner for Crewing, you will support one of the most critical functions within Allseas: ensuring our vessels are staffed with the right people, at the right time, and at the right cost.
 

You will partner closely with Crewing, Vessel Management, Human Resources, and Operations leadership, providing financial insight and decision support that enables effective workforce planning, cost management, and operational performance.
 

You will act as a trusted advisor, helping stakeholders understand financial impacts, challenge assumptions, evaluate opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

Business Partnering & Decision Support
 
 

• Partner with Crewing and Vessel Management to support operational and strategic decision-making. 

• Develop business cases, scenario analyses, and actionable recommendations. 

• Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilization. 

• Challenge assumptions and support management in making informed decisions.  

Financial Planning & Performance Management
 
 

• Lead budgeting and forecasting activities. 

• Monitor financial performance and analyse variances against budget and forecast. 

• Provide timely insights into cost drivers, trends, opportunities, and risks.  

Cost Transparency & Reporting
 
 

• Deliver reliable and business-relevant financial reporting. 

• Develop and enhance management dashboards and performance analyses.  

Process Improvement & Financial Governance
 
 

• Safeguard data integrity and compliance with financial standards and policies. 

• Identify and implement improvements in end-to-end business processes, systems (SAP, PowerBI) 

You are curious, analytical, and eager to understand how the business operates. You enjoy working with stakeholders across different disciplines and can translate complex data into practical business insights.
 

You also have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and help drive positive change.
 

Qualifications:
 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• 5 years of experience in Business Finance, Financial Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering. 

• Experience in a project-driven, engineering, offshore, maritime, or international environment is an advantage.  

Skills:
 
 

• Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

• Ability to influence and challenge constructively. 

• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and business case development. 

• Strong affinity with digital reporting solutions and data analytics. 

• Experience with SAP and Power BI is preferred. 

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

• Administration support : travels arrangements, expense claims, contacts, follow up holiday planning CCT members, Country Chair budget set up and monitoring, etc. 
 
• Communication support.. 
 
• Meetings planning, logistics preparations, minutes sharing with staff. 
 
• Support Social Investments plan and track execution. 
 
• Events preparation support : staff party, Family Day,... 
 
•   

You graduated recently or you already have a first work experience in a similar function.
 

You have excellent communication in English, French & Dutch (spoken/written).
 

You have strong administrative skills and excellent knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

jobs.occupation: Global SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment
jobs.description:
The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

lobal SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment

 

Company Overview:

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Agfa Healthcare IT is a leading provider of advanced healthcare IT solutions, offering a range of software and services that help healthcare organizations improve clinical workflows, enhance patient care, and optimize operational efficiency. Their offerings include electronic health records (EHR), picture archiving and communication systems (PACS), radiology information systems (RIS), and other imaging and data management solutions. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and cloud computing, Agfa Healthcare IT empowers healthcare providers to streamline operations, improve decision-making, and achieve better outcomes. The company's solutions are designed to be scalable, interoperable, and user-friendly, supporting healthcare providers in navigating the evolving landscape of modern healthcare delivery.

 

Position Overview / Summary:
 
• As the Global SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment, you will be responsible for evaluating, designing, implementing, measuring, and continuously improving global order fulfillment processes. Working closely with business stakeholders and external IT partners, you will ensure that processes are effectively integrated into our global SAP landscape and support business transformation, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction. You will play a key role in optimizing end-to-end workflows, driving standardization and automation initiatives, and ensuring that our order fulfillment processes remain scalable, compliant, and efficient. This position reports to the Director of Operational Excellence & Analytics. 
 

Location: (location of position):
 
• Mortsel, Belgium. Hybrid working.  

What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

You will be responsible for:

1) Customer Operations Governance & Continuous Improvement:
 
• Designing and implementing streamlined future-state processes and standardized operating procedures. 
• Identifying opportunities for process improvement, simplification, automation, and standardization across the order fulfillment lifecycle. 
• Establishing, monitoring, and analysing key performance indicators (KPIs) and process metrics to measure operational performance and business value. 
• Ensuring processes comply with industry standards, regulatory requirements, internal controls, and risk management guidelines. 
• Driving operational excellence initiatives to increase efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. 
• Developing and enhancing operational reporting and process insights to support data-driven decision making. 
2) SAP tool ownership & Transformation: 
 
• Acting as the primary business owner for Order Fulfillment-related SAP processes and solutions. 
• Serving as the liaison between business teams, IT, and external consultants to align business requirements with standard and custom SAP functionality. 
• Leading global transformation initiatives, including e-invoicing deployment, SAP enhancements, and future S/4HANA migration projects. 
• Translating business requirements into system and process solutions. 
• Defining priorities for change requests, enhancements, and project initiatives. 
• Facilitating process analysis, solution design, and business decision making. 
• Coordinating testing activities and validating system changes before deployment. 
• Managing implementation activities and driving user adoption through effective change management. 
• Monitoring industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and assessing their relevance to Agfa HealthCare. 
 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

You will work closely with teams across Finance, Purchasing, IT, and other Business Process Management functions to ensure seamless end-to-end process execution.

This includes supporting initiatives such as Vendor Management, Customer contract management, Licensing Management.

 

Who You Are (Qualifications):
 
• Masters's degree in Business Administration or equivalent experience 
• Strong experience in business process management, operational excellence, or order fulfillment operations. 
• Advanced knowledge of SAP modules (SD, PS, MM) in SAP EEC environment 
• Familiarity with S/4 HANA is a plus 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills. 
• Strong communication skills in English 
• Process improvement & problem solving mindset 
• Proven ability to influence and drive change across functions without direct authority. 
• Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities in a global environment.

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The Role
 

As our Office Assistant, you are the organizational heart of our office. You keep things running smoothly behind the scenes, make sure colleagues and visitors feel welcome and appreciated, and give our team a helping hand wherever it's needed.
 

The tasks listed below give you a taste of what the job involves, but they are only one part of the package. As a growing scale-up, our needs change quickly, and this role grows along with them. Whenever something needs to be organized, followed up or simply picked up, you're the person who jumps in.
 

Reception and general office support
 
 

• Be the first point of contact for visitors and suppliers, phone calls. 

• Handle incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries. 

• Order office supplies, keep track of stock levels and make sure we never run out of the essentials. 

• Order laptops for new employees.  

Recruitment support
 
 

• Support in recruitment by screening resumes 

• Schedule and organize interviews (coordinate agendas, invite candidates, book rooms and welcome candidates on site). 

• Keep candidate administration up to date and help ensure every candidate has a positive experience with Zymofix.  

Accounting support:
 
 

• Support in purchasing, shipping and logistics (sent packages via DHL, provide necessary documentation,...) 

• Follow-up on goods purchased by staff: tickets, reimbursements,...  

Work clothes and office supplies:
 
 

• Follow up on the work clothes and personal protective equipment for our team: track needs and sizes, order on time and manage stock. 

• Keep the office stocked with supplies and act as a contact point for suppliers.  

Employee engagement:
 
 

• Organize the end-of-year Christmas gifts for the team, from choosing and ordering to wrapping and distributing. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You are very well organized: you’re able to keep an overview, plan ahead and you don’t lose track of deadlines or details. 

• You are a true all-rounder who genuinely enjoys supporting others.  

• You switch quickly and easily between different tasks and keep your cool when priorities shift. 

• You are open to taking on new tasks and like to grow along with a fast-growing company. 

• You are hands-on, proactive and spot what needs to be done before anyone asks. 

• You are a people person with a warm, welcoming attitude, both towards colleagues and visitors. 

• You handle confidential information, such as candidate data, with discretion. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• You work comfortably with standard office tools.

• Do you thrive on challenging supplier pricing and uncovering cost-saving opportunities?
• Are you equally comfortable with data analysis and commercial negotiations?
• Looking for a dynamic role in an international environment where no two days are the same?
Then this opportunity might be exactly what you're looking for.

As a Technical Buyer, you will play a crucial role in driving procurement performance across long-term projects. Your primary focus will be identifying and realizing savings opportunities while building strong, strategic relationships with suppliers. You will challenge cost increases, perform market analyses, develop compelling business cases, and negotiate optimal commercial conditions.

Our client is an international supply chain specialist serving the automotive industry. The company manages the procurement and distribution of fastening solutions and technical components for leading manufacturers worldwide.

This position combines analytical problem-solving with stakeholder management and requires someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and market conditions continuously evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze supplier price increase requests and assess their impact on procurement budgets.
• Conduct market research and benchmarking to validate pricing proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.
• Develop and present fact-based business cases to support negotiations and purchasing decisions.
• Lead commercial discussions with suppliers and negotiate the best possible pricing and contractual conditions.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing suppliers.
• Organize and participate in supplier performance reviews and business meetings.
• Monitor market trends and proactively identify risks and opportunities within the supply chain.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Manage purchasing activities for strategic, long-term projects from analysis through implementation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• 2 to 5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, procurement or a comparable commercial role.
• Proven experience in supplier negotiations and achieving measurable cost reductions.
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Commercially driven with the confidence to challenge suppliers and defend your position using facts and data.
• Experience within a technical, manufacturing or automotive-related environment is considered a strong advantage.
• Familiarity with procurement terminology, sourcing methodologies and supplier management processes.
• Fluency in English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

Production | Quality Control | Team Leadership | Rework | 5S | 3-Shift System

As a Production & Quality Team Leader, you will supervise a team of Operators and Inspectors. You organize the daily workload based on priorities, skills and available capacity, while ensuring that quality and production targets are achieved.

Your new companyYou will join an operational manufacturing environment where quality, safety and efficiency are key. As a Production & Quality Team Leader, you supervise Operators and Inspectors and ensure that production, inspection and rework activities are performed according to the required quality and safety standards.

Your new role
